title: Warehouse Associate
text: Dependable warehouse associate with three years of experience picking, packing and shipping high volumes of orders accurately. Certified forklift operator who trains new hires on safety procedures and keeps throughput steady under pressure.

title: Logistics Team Member
text: Detail-oriented logistics team member who consistently exceeds daily order targets while maintaining a clean safety record. Comfortable with pallet jacks, forklifts and inventory scanners, and known for helping teammates during peak season.
